title: F1054: population aged 15 years and over, by principal economic status and age group
used_for:
Design 5.2 joint population validation. The person-level joint of age and principal economic status, compared cell by cell against the synthesised town. It found I-069: the population matched every marginal and had the joint wrong by a third.

NOT INDEPENDENT since I-069's fix. It shares underlying Census 2022 counts with FY047B, which the population is now fitted to - proven by the identical 4,136,852 national 15+ total and by each table partitioning the State. A pass against it is a CONSISTENCY CHECK and belongs in the calibration-exposed table, not the independent one.
